summary: Quiet tape. Few names separated from the benchmark, so the pick list stays short.

pick.thesis: Alphabet keeps making higher lows while the benchmark chops sideways. Pullbacks have been bought quickly, which suggests persistent demand rather than a one-off gap.
risks: Momentum reversal after an extended run
pick.invalidation: A close back below the recent range low while the benchmark holds firm.

pick.thesis: NVIDIA has lagged the benchmark across the lookback window and recent rebounds faded fast. The weakness looks persistent rather than a single event.
pick.invalidation: A close back above the recent range high on rising volume.

pick.thesis: Broadcom is moving broadly in line with the benchmark. Signals conflict, so the stance is to watch for a decisive break rather than lean either way.
pick.invalidation: A sustained move away from the benchmark in either direction.
